subject: Generative trees — kickoff
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kickoff for the generative trees workstream, from our ICML release on adversarial and copycat training of tree-based generative models. Two components matter: the Wrapper class trains a generative tree via the copycat approach, and the Generate class samples from a pretrained model or produces density plots. Trees give us tabular synthesis that is interpretable and cheap — no GPU training loop at all.

Product goal for graphs-retrieval: synthetic tabular data for partner sandboxes, so external partners develop against realistic-but-fake tables. Milestones: reproduce the Iris example and validate fidelity metrics by May 22, run on two internal tables by Jun 19, sandbox pilot decision Jul 17.

Katya, Jorge and Yusuf assigned.

Anders
